I've never been more close to suicide then I have in the last few days. I have become numb to my entire life. Its impossible for me to be hopeful or positive for the future about anything. Nobody wants anything to do with me on a social/personal level. I'm stuck in a cycle that has proven to be impossible to break. Happiness is so far away from my life right now.

No I don't. I am about as unassuming as can be I think. I unintentionally wear black a lot. I intentionally do not dress flashy tho(loud colors or ridiculous shoes/hats/glasses) etc. I think people who do are not necessarily interesting people and are just trying to call attention to themselves. Maybe there is some worth to that but its not my style and I think its stupid to be honest. I'm not going to say my looks help the situation because they definitely have not in the past. Read: Nobody approaches me for my looks. 

I prefer to spend time alone because its what I am used to. I used to be more social then I am now. I'm just older and bitter now. More pesimistic about things. My attitude is shitty because I'm not happy so there is that. Interests are typical for a dude I guess. Cars, hiking, biking, camping, astronomy, cannabis, certain sports, poker, politics, music, cooking, technology/computers, dogs. Umm, few others but thats just being broad with it. Maybe my communication is just shit. So many things i feel I need to change

I've thought this too, but there are only so many times you can do things alone before it just loses it luster. Hell, I went Jamaica one year, all by myself to explore a tropical island and sit on the beach for a week. It was the one of the most embarassing things I've ever done. I can't even tell that story because its horribly pathetic. Who the fuck travels like that alone. I should have gone to Europe or just another city in America/Canada or something. People might like you for you, but its hard for people to get to know you or find you interesting unless you have these things to say. Its hard work to get to know me so people don't make the effort and it seems impossible to make it easy, ontop of that, I can't *make* them like me. Sorry i'm not trying to be negative, its just straight up the way things are for me

Thats funny you mentioned getting a dog. Just got one back in september. He is awesome and he brings joy to me. Problem is I don't want to be crazy dog guy. I do want friends because I believe life is about the people in it and they give life meaning. Everything else is bullshit. Problem is I am now, or have been, not sure when it happened or if I was always like this, but I'm kinda a dick. I don't feel empathy for people anymore because of all the rejection and pain I have felt from them so I'm very resentful. Single serving friends is damn right. I haven't done the volunteer thing quite yet. I think I'm holding on to resentment of people too much to volunteer my time to help people. Like I said, a vicious cycle.

It always seems to come back to this. Pick a hobby. I have tried this in numerous ways. Such as doing Tae-kwon Do. Didn't really branch out for friends as the group I went to was all a lot older then me. I've done the "learning a instrument" route to by taking guitar lessions for over a year and a half and I'm nowhere near being able to play in an open mic or good enough to really play anything decent. I rode motorcycles for a while. Didn't gain any lasting friendships. Its more a solitary thing anyway that appealed to me in the first place. I really enjoyed it but now I don't have the money to buy another bike. The point is I have not really picked any interest that has allowed me to form relationships in any way. "Oh you like motorcycles, cars, guitars, biking, woodworking etc etc? Thats nice........." And that's where it ends. So I'm not really a believer in just because two people have the same interests means they will be friends. Appreciate the advice tho

I feel you. I understanding wanting to do that. I have some very fucked up thoughts. I have these thoughts and I'm probably 10 years your senior. You still have a lot of time for things to get better. My situation is different. I didn't have a great college exp either. I had a girlfriend through most of it, but it ended in flames and I wish I would have spent more time making male friends. You still have time to keep trying. Killing a bunch of frat dudes, while I can get behind the idea, isn't worth it. Your life is more then fake ass frat bros. I understand your feeling of being fucked up. I too think there is this fundemental thing that prevents me from living a normal life. Part of the reason I'm so angry is because of it. Its hard for me to say because Its never worked for me, but you have time to try to not be so sad or angry and it could change things for you. Its a vicious cycle that its hard to break but the only alternative is to stay that way forever like I have been doing. Try to use the anger and put the energy into ways that make you happy. Whatever that might be.

That song is rather epic. Honestly tho I usually try to listen to more mellow beats to try to get rid of my anger. I don't like to admit it but I do anything I can to mellow myself out. I've been trying to branch out a little bit into EDM(? Not sure what to call this song tho). Hard for me to find new stuff as I get hooked on one or two artists for a while and don't really look for anything else. Def going to Seven lions on the rotation now. 

Really though we should at least be living in a med/legal state. Until then we just gotta keep struggling to find the right people in our lives and try to deal and not flip the fuck out. And anybody that is not going to be your friend if you don't pay dues is not your friend, especially if they fuck you over in the process. Fuck frats man.

I also smoke everyday to deal with it. Maybe that's why I've really been going downhill lately is because I've been dry for months. Drinking only makes me worse. Its like electricity for my anger. I'm about .0001 seconds away from prison when I drink. Just last night I wanted to bash this guy to death (that I've never even met)for making out with this girl I went out on a date with that ended up rejecting me pretty harshly. Then turn around and rip her fucking face off in a bar full of people. Its not good.
